text: **Review complete.** I verified that while the automated walkthrough test passed (1/1 expected), the product has three critical blockers: (1) documentation describes an OKR tool but the code is a ward notes app, creating misaligned runbooks; (2) core features are missing—no POST endpoint to add notes, empty client UI, and wrong empty-state text; and (3) dependencies aren't installed, breaking local testing. The REVIEW.md details these findings and a remediation path.
